mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verifications ( email, otp_hash, purpose, expires_at, attempts ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{otpHash}, #{purpose, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{expiresAt}, #{attempts} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, otp_hash, purpose, expires_at, attempts, verified_at, created_at FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND verified_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verifications SET verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND verified_at IS NULL
